Game Overview

In Save Tree, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a world of peril where trees need your protection. Save Tree challenges you to battle sinister forces, rescue charming sapling allies, and upgrade your capabilities. With automated progress and strategic depth, this adventure ensures that even in your absence, growth never pauses. Become a legendary tree guardian!
